subject: Re: Quick technical run-through for BuildLane (developer intent from docs CTA)
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@buildlane.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Developer intent - quickstart -> technical demo request

Hi Mateo,

I clicked through the docs CTA yesterday (developer quickstart) and would love a short technical demo for our engineering team at BuildLane. We're evaluating faster inference for our search + code-assist features and want to understand: model variants you recommend, latency profiles on dedicated capacity, and how prefix caching/batching would map to our typical request size (avg 300 tokens, spikes to 1k).

High-level:
- Team: 3 backend engs + 1 ML engineer (Andrew Li)
- PoC timeline: 6–8 weeks
- Estimated qps: 2–10 (bursty)

Can we do a 30–45m technical run-through next week? Prefer PST afternoons but open to Tue/Wed morning. I've attached a short architecture outline (buildlane-integration-outline.pdf) — that should help guide the agenda.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of Platform
BuildLane

Attachments: buildlane-integration-outline.pdf (1 page PDF)

- Fri Apr 23, 11:30–12:15
- Tue Apr 27, 13:00–13:45

If none of those work, here's my Calendly with additional options: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30m?deal=DL-4891

- 5m intros
- 10m infra & goals (your team)

Hi Priya — adding a quick technical note before we lock a slot. Afternoon PST works best for my schedule. For the demo it would be helpful if you can share a sample request/response (anonymized) and the rough model size you expect (e.g., a 7B or 13B variant) so I can tailor the kernel/quantization discussion.

Quick questions:
- Is your traffic steady or highly spiky (we can show burst handling & fallback policies)
- Any latency SLOs we should plan around (p50/p95)?

Example payload (pseudocode) we typically test with:
POST /v1/generate
{ "input": "<user code sample>
Describe next steps...", "max_tokens": 512 }

If Fri 11:30 PST is still available for you, that would be my first choice. Otherwise Tue afternoon also works.

—Camila
Senior ML Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <priya@buildlane.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Andrew Li <andrew@buildlane.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Developer intent - quickstart -> technical demo request

Thanks both — Fri Apr 23 11:30 PST works for us. Please include Andrew (ML) on the invite (cc'd).

Quick answers to Camila's questions:
- Traffic: moderately spiky — baseline low (1–2 qps) but expected spikes up to ~12 qps during internal events.
- Latency SLOs: aiming for p95 < 400ms for single-turn generation (we can be flexible during PoC).

I'll share an anonymized sample payload after this thread (sending separately because it contains customer snippets). Also filing a security questionnaire with our legal team — will forward SOC2 questions if they pop up.

See you Fri — Priya
Head of Platform, BuildLane
